title: [main] Incorrect Additional Currency Base and Additional Currency Amount calculation in VAT/GST Entries when Line Discount is applied on Sales Invoice in the Australian version
summary: Fixes incorrect Additional Currency Base and Additional Currency Amount in VAT/GST entries in the Australian version by changing purchase invoice posting. The change brings additional fixes and regression tests from the 29.x branch into main.
key_points: Corrects Additional Currency Base and Additional Currency Amount calculations when line discounts are applied
Addresses VAT/GST entry calculations in purchase posting for APAC/Australian localization
Includes regression tests to prevent similar issues in the future
Aligns main branch with fixes from 29.x branch after review feedback
quote: Brings the differences between 29.x PR #11723 and main PR #11434 into main, following review comments on the 29.x PR.
